status: implementation contract / peer transport activation gated
purpose: Bind content-addressed data transfer and delegated computation to existing CGX identity, execution leases, receipts and readback without creating a second runtime or transferring semantic authority.
identity_rules: node identity is distinct from agent identity and semantic authority
surface identity is not node identity
storage volume or carrier is not an independent compute node unless compute capability and independent process identity are proven
node capability claims require current readback evidence
transfer_rules: source bytes remain authoritative until exact target readback verifies the same sha256 and size
copy or transport never transfers semantic, governance or release authority
target mutation requires DIGITAL_WRITE or stronger lease when execution is requested
existing identical payload may be reused without byte-for-byte retransmission
existing non-identical target is a conflict and must not be overwritten silently
partial transfer remains staging only and cannot satisfy downstream compute dependency
verified transfer receipt is operational evidence, not canonical promotion
compute_rules: delegated compute requires COMPUTE_ONLY or stronger current scoped execution lease
compute request may reference transferred inputs only after verified target readback
raw instruction is transport context and is not semantic authority
arbitrary shell execution is not a node capability
executor must be a registered deterministic tool, solver, simulation capability or existing Cognigrex/LightSpeed workflow
resource budget is a ceiling and heavy execution remains separately gated
result values remain unknown until receipted execution
compute receipt must identify node, capability, input manifest hash, result refs and execution provenance
compute output does not authorise canonical promotion, provider writes, publication or actuation
receipt_rules: Task_ID and Run_ID lineage is preserved across transfer and compute
source and destination hashes are retained

surface_bindings.desktop: full local transfer/compute execution when current lease and tool policy allow
surface_bindings.web: bounded status, planning and receipt projection; node-exchange queue activation requires the host root registry; no direct public execution
surface_bindings.mobile: projection-lite status, owner review and planning; node-exchange queue activation requires the host root registry
surface_bindings.chat: intent, orchestration and review; local bytes move through node/runtime capability rather than conversation memory
surface_bindings.node: signed peer capability, verified transfer, leased compute and receipt return

activation.local_compute: may use existing LightSpeed/Cognigrex runtime when its current execution preflights pass
activation.local_volume_transfer: may be tested in isolated approved roots with exact hash readback
activation.host_root_registry: required before queued transfer activation; machine-local configuration maps stable root IDs to allowlisted paths and action payloads may not self-authorize filesystem paths
activation.peer_transfer: requires authenticated peer transport adapter and explicit target-node identity
activation.peer_compute: requires independently proven target compute node plus current lease
activation.public_relay: transport exposure is not execution authority; owner authentication and private HTTPS boundary remain required

current_claim_boundary: BouwerBase local computation has independent operational receipts
a mounted secondary volume may prove carrier readback but does not by itself prove peer compute
off-device peer computation remains unproven until a second independently connected compute node is exercised

rolling_observer_facet.status: opt-in read-only candidate / live peer, calibration and publication gates remain held
rolling_observer_facet.owner: existing CGX FileSpace/DataSpace contract; not a separate InterSpace, runtime, database, scheduler, security system or canonical state
rolling_observer_facet.prerequisite: upstream trusted adapter validates device identity, receipts, sensor calibration and time; boolean receipt_verified is only a precondition marker, never a cryptographic proof
distribution_rules: Do not ship entire local trajectory to peers by default; this projection is local-only and not a wire frame.
Public or external delivery uses existing approved signed/authenticated transport and explicit release gates.
Context roots and chosen observer/phase set are authenticated context, not encryption keys.
Transport energy/frequency/ambient-backscatter selection requires authorised device and spectrum qualification.
No unchanged-state assumption on missing packet; short 0→+1→0 events must be preserved when relevant.
Models, semantic views, source data and associated rights remain with their canonical owner.
No physical inference promoted by observation quorum alone; withhold on disagreement or unresolved model.

operation_binding.data_space: bounded event/state projection and preexisting node_exchange root/receipt/lease rules
operation_binding.print_space: qualified sensor/tag devices supply real receipts; manufacturing and physical controls unchanged
operation_binding.operator: existing LS GO/Achilles authenticated review only

rolling_observer_facet.acceptance_owner: existing owner review issue #161; internal review protection issue #158

configurable_n_dataspace_facet.status: review_only / locally computed candidate; not transport, cryptography, physical authority or separate datastore
configurable_n_dataspace_facet.owner: Cognigrex.cgx FileSpace Object_ID + geometry/semantic/model/state roots; inherits existing DataSpace node exchange

topology.nodes: ids, ownership evidence references, public/restricted/private visibility, external access policy refs
topology.selection: include/exclude partition of all declared nodes; no silent substitution of unavailable nodes
topology.interfaces: kind, 1..16 included node IDs, registered geometric/frame/displacement/measurement model reference
topology.derivables: registered deterministic function reference, input interface IDs, units; no automatic inference
topology.relationships: typed known endpoints, evidence provenance; physical links require independent verification
topology.semantic_lenses: existing registered view references bound to derivables; subjective/local interpretation never becomes fact
topology.current_profiles: one profile per authorised FileSpace scope; profile edits change the context root and force renegotiation

context.profile_fingerprint: canonical SHA-256 of local scoped profile; treat as potentially revealing and keep behind authenticated access
context.version_rule: both ends reconcile exact profile root and prior state root before compact delta
context.no_plaintext_secrets: no keys, passwords, recovery tokens or private catalogue material in profile, logs or public routing
context.dns_boundary: domain control proof is namespace discovery, not device permission, data rights or spectrum access
context.authority: signed identity, scoped leases, source licence and state/DBR authority stay external owner gates

alphabet: null=unknown; never substitute zero or unchanged
delta.transaction: sequence + window timestamp + Object_ID + exact profile/prior/result roots
delta.receiver: reject mismatched prior/profile roots, replay sequence, duplicate keys, malformed symbols and changed-state hash
delta.intermediate_events: window-to-window compression does not substitute for required event history; preserve 0,+1,0 when consequential

physical_transport.rule: An observed idle channel, DNS namespace or compliant band alone does not authorise using another operator's infrastructure. External licences/equipment/test evidence and the existing lease gates remain mandatory.
physical_transport.separation: RF sampling ≠ transmission cadence; channel observation ≠ a message; receiver context ≠ cryptographic secrecy.

configurable_n_dataspace_facet.receipt_boundary: Functions only validate typed structures and exact deterministic state projection; boolean receipt markers/authority references MUST come from verified upstream adapters and do not themselves verify signatures.
configurable_n_dataspace_facet.privacy: No private node roster, geometry selection, source evidence or inner state in a public discovery packet. Authenticated per-scope projection, metadata-minimising opaque reference where possible.
gates: existing #158 private asset and LS GO access control
